text:
Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is a German politician.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
PrussianStateParliament(y) ::: y is the Prussian State Parliament.
NaziReichstag(y) ::: y is the Nazi Reichstag.

Premises:
HeinrichSchmidt is a German politician.
HeinrichSchmidt was a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.

Conclusion:
∃x (German(x) ∧ Politician(x) ∧ Member(x, PrussianStateParliament) ∧ Member(x, NaziReichstag))
